messages:
maria: Quick async rollup for Q1 milestone owners — short status on what actually shipped, what slipped, and one-line next steps. Please reply with owner tag + ETA if changed.

samir: Shipped: model routing policy + rollout API (PR #4821) — canary live in us-west, latency looks good. Deployed yesterday. No regressions. :tada:

alisa: Slipped: auto-batching optimizer. Blocked by memory regression on 80k seq tests. Root cause narrowed to kernel selection fallback. Owning fix — @kevin.

kevin: Confirmed. Kernel fallback change causes perf cliff on Ampere 80GB config. I'll coordinate with infra + runtime team. ETA EOD Fri for patch, then perf runs.

ezra: Shipped: console cost breakdown and route-level charts (feature flagged). QA caught a mismatch with token attribution — small fix merged. Flagged for product rollout next Wed.

maria: Dependencies: perf runs for auto-batching must finish before we can enable batch-by-default for Dedicated. If Kevin's patch lands Fri, ops needs 24h to validate.

alisa: If ops validation looks green, can we enable gradual canary for Dedicated on Mon? Need 2% -> 10% ramp.

samir: Note about model catalog: redwood/model-v1.3 has quantized variants — we should ensure routing policy includes quantized fallback in low-capacity zones. I added an integration test in PR #4873.

maria: Outstanding action items:
- @kevin: kernel patch ETA EOD Fri, post-patch perf results
- @ops (ops-team): 24h validation window after perf green
- @alisa: ready canary roll plan (2%->10%) and rollback criteria
- @samir: confirm catalog routing tests cover quantized fallback

kevin: I’ll post perf logs here + gist when ready. Quick note: kernel patch needs one small ABI bump; may require dedicated package publish. Ops heads-up.

deploy-bot: Canary started for route /v1/generate-dedicated on us-west-2 at 2024-11-01T14:20Z (2% traffic). [deploy-id: dpl-2024-11-01-003]

maria: Thanks — can everyone react with :thumbsup: when they’ve captured their action? We'll reconvene in-thread Friday if any slips.
